The Final Stop on Route 9

The dashboard clock flickers to midnight on November 26th, 2026, casting a pale, sickly light over Elias’s white-knuckled grip on the steering wheel.

In the back row sits a passenger in a damp yellow coat, her face hidden by the thick, freezing fog pressing against the windows.

She hasn't pulled the cord in twenty miles, and Elias whispers to the empty rearview mirror that the fare is paid in full.

He stops at the final depot, but the doors remain sealed shut as the smell of stagnant pond water slowly fills the cabin.

The passenger steps forward and Elias sees his own name on the hospital tag on her wrist, finally realizing the fare is paid in full.
